observations: Industrial flatbed lockstitch sewing machine mounted on a table with stand and foot pedal.
Red oval 'Emel' logo visible on the machine head in photos 0, 1, and 2.
Small plate near the needle area reads something like 'EM 8500' but is not fully sharp/legible in any photo.
Thread stand and bobbin winder attached above the machine; yellow-handled scissors resting on the table.
Visible dust and grime on the machine body and some rust spots on the vertical thread-stand pole and table legs.
Motor is not visible in any photo (table skirting/stand blocks the underside).
No photo shows the machine powered on, running, or a stitching sample.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'DEBISPAK' overlay all three photos; otherwise consistent background (same room, same table) across shots.

claims.evidence: Brand logo clearly visible on machine head in photos 0, 1, 2

Photos 0-2 show dust/grime on the machine casing and rust spots on the thread-stand pole and table legs, inconsistent with 'very good' cosmetic condition; no running/stitch test shown to support functional claim

risks.risk: Machine may not run or may have motor/belt faults
risks.proof: A short video of the machine powered on, foot pedal pressed, needle moving and producing a stitch line on fabric

risks.risk: Motor type and condition unknown (clutch vs servo, wiring state)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the motor under the table including any brand/model sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced as base clutch motor, unverified condition

risks.risk: Rust on thread stand/table legs may indicate longer exposure/age or storage in damp conditions, possibly affecting internal parts
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted areas and the underside of the table/stand
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavier wear/age than stated

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (bobbins, extra needles, knee lifter) not shown
risks.proof: Photo of accessory drawer/kit included with machine
risks.if_unproven: priced as machine only, no extras

proof_requests: Video of the machine running and stitching a sample seam
Clear close-up of the nameplate/model number
Photo of the motor underneath the table
Close-up of rusted thread-stand pole and table legs
Photo of any included accessories (bobbins, needles, oil can)
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an Emel industrial lockstitch sewing machine on a table/stand, so it can be priced; the 'very good condition' claim is contradicted by visible dust and rust, and no functional test is shown, so it must be priced at the worst-case (unverified working, visible cosmetic wear) until further proof is given.
